# Dist files

This directory contains the prebuilt single-file bot for **copy-paste deployments** in the Cloudflare dashboard — see [Deployment Guide](../doc/en/DEPLOY.md).

Wrangler CLI deploys (`pnpm run deploy`) and Git deployments (Cloudflare Workers Builds) do **not** use this folder: they build from source and deploy `packages/apps/workers/dist/index.js` via [wrangler.jsonc](../wrangler.jsonc).

## Files

- [index.js](index.js): The bot for Cloudflare Workers (single self-contained file), generated by `pnpm run build:dist`.
